_readme: Config for the Charleston Insider's Guide monthly market refresh. The scheduled Cowork session reads this, makes the Flexmls MCP calls described in RECIPE.md, writes data.json, then runs refresh.py. This file is the single source of truth for how each neighborhood is defined. Do not rely on project memory: it is unreachable from an unattended run.

global.footer_template: Market data prepared by Jimmy Farrell / The Farrell Group · {MONTH} {YEAR} · All data deemed reliable but not guaranteed
global.no_active_data: HARD RULE from Jimmy, 2026-07-28: no active-listing statistics anywhere on this page, panels or prose. Active counts, active median list, low active list, active median DOM are all banned. Every published figure must come from closed sales.

panels.name: French Quarter
panels.filter: MLSAreaMinor Eq '51 - Peninsula Charleston Inside of Crosstown'

panels.name: Garden District
panels.note_fixed: The MLS files the Garden District as Wraggborough. 'Garden District' returns zero listings.

panels.name: Cannonborough/Elliotborough
panels.note_fixed: Three MLS codes cover this one neighborhood and must be merged.

panels.name: Westside
panels.filter: SubdivisionName Eq 'Westside','Bee Street Lofts','Bee Street Condominiums'
panels.note_fixed: Jimmy confirmed the Bee Street condo buildings belong to Westside and are merged in.

panels.name: James Island
panels.note_fixed: First four stats are detached only. Attached median is pulled separately with PropertySubType Eq 'Single Family Attached'. Total Volume is all sub-types.

panels.name: Daniel Island
panels.note_fixed: High null-DOM rate (~15%), mostly builder closings entered after the fact. Any speed claim needs the 'never publicly marketed' qualifier.

panels.name: Park Circle
panels.note_fixed: A subdivision, not an area. Sits inside MLS area 31. New-construction closings priced at exactly list flatter the list-to-sale ratio.

panels.name: Folly Beach
panels.filter: MLSAreaMinor Eq '22 - Folly Beach to Battery Island'
panels.note_fixed: The $100K floor is MANDATORY. MLS Area 22 files marina slips and parking spaces at 2 McDonough Rd and 66-67 W 9th/10th St as residential sales, ten of them between $16K and $52K. Nothing exists between $100K and $275,300, so any floor in that range gives the identical set. Do not raise it.

panels.name: Sullivan's Island
panels.note_fixed: The apostrophe in "43 - Sullivan's Island" breaks a literal Eq in _filter. Use startswith. High null-DOM rate (~17%); same qualifier as Daniel Island.

panels.name: Isle of Palms
panels.note_fixed: Wild Dunes is MLS area 45, already excluded from area 44. Pull it separately for the note: SubdivisionName Eq 'Wild Dunes','Wild Dunes Resort','Wild Dunes Yacht Harbor'.

panels.name: West Ashley
panels.filter: MLSAreaMinor Eq '11 - West of the Ashley Inside I-526','12 - West of the Ashley Outside I-526','13 - West of the Ashley beyond Rantowles Creek'

panels.name: South Mount Pleasant
panels.filter: MLSAreaMinor Eq '42 - Mt Pleasant S of IOP Connector'

panels.name: North Mount Pleasant
panels.filter: MLSAreaMinor Eq '41 - Mt Pleasant N of IOP Connector'
panels.note_fixed: Section id is misleading; this really is the North Mount Pleasant panel.

french_quarter_boundary.description: Jimmy's original Flexmls map polygon. Geo search is disabled on the MCP feed, so rebuild by pulling every Area 51 closing with UnparsedAddress and assigning by street.
excluded_traps: Elliott St and Bedons Alley are SOUTH of Broad. The MLS codes most of them 'South of Broad'. Jimmy's call is to EXCLUDE them.
103 and 106 Church St sit just below the Broad crossing at roughly #105-110. Exclude.
Dockside (330 Concord St) is north of Market. Exclude.
Gadsdenboro is north of Calhoun. Exclude.
Fort Sumter House (1 King St) is south of Broad. Exclude.
french_quarter_boundary.judge_by_address_not_subdivision: Four included listings are miscoded 'South of Broad' (4 Prioleau, 55 Concord, 75 Concord, 4 Exchange). Listings coded 'None', 'Downtown', 'City of Charleston' or 'Historic District' are legitimate candidates. Always judge by street address.

superlative_claims._why: Four superlative claims on the April 2026 page were false, and had been false when written. Recompute the holder of each every run and rewrite the prose if it changed. Never carry a superlative forward.
superlative_claims._collect_even_if_not_displayed: data.json MUST carry every metric listed in checks below for ALL 12 peninsula panels, even when that metric is not one of the panel's six displayed stats. Otherwise the winner is picked from a partial pool and the check silently lies. Caught during the 2026-07-28 build: only Wagener Terrace carried total_volume, so the volume check named it the leader when South of Broad is 6.8x larger.
